'''August 2001 Austin tournament (25 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Junior's Comics, Austin, Texas on 25 August 2001. It is known from Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2892">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-austin-texas-08-25-01d2892/ austin-texas-08-25-01], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 25 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-austin-texas-08-25-01d2892/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Junior's Comics, Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
